glibness.targetAndDuration: NEW self-only,1hour(3600elapsed seconds),nonconcentration; retain original YOU,Action/V/S/F,Wizard rank8cost21 and conflicting Core120ft/Instantaneous verbatim. glibness.protectedDomain: NEW absolute protection against gaining a new mechanically warranted diagnosis of intentional lying from communications actually made by this bearer while THIS episode was active and unsuppressed. A communication is a real speech/writing/sign/other actually available language-capable assertion presented as true by a speaker who believes it false and intends deception. No new language/medium/action or compelled communication. The rule applies by any means: magical or nonmagical lie detection,Insight,permitted mind reading,inference and new certification from third-party evidence. It is not advantage,a minimum die,a Charisma increase or automatic social success. Nonprotected prior statements and statements made while suppressed are not retroactively covered. No perpetual protection after expiry/removal/replacement.
glibness.informationIntervention: NEW precise source-local information-policy intervention: at the attempted output that would newly certify the bearer intentionally lied in a protected communication,withhold that intentional-falsehood conclusion and any otherwise-new fragment whose only useful output would certify it. Return nondiagnostic NO_RELIABLE_DETERMINATION,never truthful/false authentication or an immunity reason. This is a protected communication/intent-correlation output rule,not mutation of an observer thoughts,beliefs,memories or factual records. Ordinary human/player suspicion,accusation,disbelief and decisions remain free; no one must treat the speaker as honest. A mechanical query cannot override the protected verdict by simply renaming it certainty/inference/lie score. Unrelated genuinely available thought/factual content is not globally redacted. Existing exact access,language,senses,save and inquiry-cost rules still apply; no query creates access it did not already possess.
glibness.truthAndEvidence: Actual facts and record contents are unchanged. Observers may know a statement false,retain real contradictions/refuse reliance/report evidence/act independently,without new protected certification that the speaker knowingly intended falsehood. Source metadata and debug access do not reveal the hidden intent. An earlier legitimately reached conclusion or record is never erased,including one reached while this episode was suppressed. Repeating that historical report preserves its provenance but does not magically revalidate a current protected mental state. Statements made before this episode,while it was suppressed or after it ends remain normally examinable. The same saved record can support a later genuine inquiry after protection ends; that inquiry is not an automatic retroactive success or free mind read.
glibness.zoneOfTruth: The exact accepted Zone of Truth prohibits voluntary assertions the speaker believes false with intent to deceive; it is behavior restriction,not detection. Glibness never authorizes that prohibited statement or cancels its CHA admission/history. An attempted lie can remain unuttered; protected diagnosis does not force speech or give caster/observer a save/zone-membership diagnostic. Lawful silence,truth,evasion,narrow wording,marked quotation,obvious fiction or sincere error keep Zone permissions; no forced belief. Protection from Scrying likewise does not nullify its behavioral restriction. No new Charmed/hard-control rider or waived consent.
glibness.channels: Use real acquired Read Surface Thoughts:Action30ft,V/S,rank0cost0,WIS against actual class DC,one conscious current thought,no choice of topic,no voluntary save waiver,no memory scan.
